## 表格布局

<table>
  <table-row>
    <table-cell>**名称**</table-cell>
    <table-cell>**状态**</table-cell>
    <table-cell align="end">**数量**</table-cell>
  </table-row>
  <table-row>
    <table-cell>项目 A</table-cell>
    <table-cell><badge color="success">完成</badge></table-cell>
    <table-cell align="end">100</table-cell>
  </table-row>
  <table-row>
    <table-cell>项目 B</table-cell>
    <table-cell><badge color="warning">进行中</badge></table-cell>
    <table-cell align="end">50</table-cell>
  </table-row>
</table>

## 可点击布局容器

{@body const [active,setActive] = DIL.useState("A")}
<box border radius="lg" padding={3} gap={2}>
  {#each ["A","B","C"] as x}
    <pressable padding={3} radius="md" background={active===x?"surface-tertiary":"surface-secondary"} onClick={()=>setActive(x)}>
      <row align="center" justify="between">
        **模块 {x}**
        {#if active===x}
          <badge color="success">当前选中</badge>
        {:else}
          <icon name="chevron-right"/>
        {/if}
      </row>
    </pressable>
  {/each}
</box>

## 浮层布局

<popover>
  <popover-trigger>
    <button color="secondary" variant="outline">打开浮层布局 <icon name="chevron-down"/></button>
  </popover-trigger>
  <popover-content>
    <box gap={2}>
      **浮层内容区域**
      <text color="secondary" size="sm">可以放置菜单、说明和按钮。</text>
      <button size="sm" block>执行操作</button>
    </box>
  </popover-content>
</popover>

## 功能菜单

<grid columns={3} gap={2}>
  <each values={[["folder","文档"],["settings","设置"],["chart-line","报表"]]} alias="item">
    <grid-item>
      <box background="surface-secondary" radius="md" padding={3} align="center" gap={2}>
        <icon name={item[0]} size="xl"/>
        <text size="sm">{item[1]}</text>
      </box>
    </grid-item>
  </each>
</grid>

## 可选择列表

{@body const [selectedList,setSelectedList] = DIL.useState(["设计"])}
<box border radius="lg" padding={3} gap={2}>
  **选择你需要的功能**
  {#each ["设计","开发","测试","部署","维护"] as x}
    <pressable padding={2} radius="md" background={selectedList.includes(x)?"surface-secondary":"surface"} onClick={()=>setSelectedList(old=>old.includes(x)?old.filter(v=>v!==x):[...old,x])}>
      <row align="center">
        <icon name={selectedList.includes(x)?"check-circle-2":"circle"} color={selectedList.includes(x)?"success":"secondary"}/>
        <box flex="1">{x}</box>
        {#if selectedList.includes(x)}
          <badge color="success">已选择</badge>
        {/if}
      </row>
    </pressable>
  {/each}
  <divider color="subtle"/>
  <text size="sm">已选 {selectedList.length} 项：{selectedList.join("、")||"暂无"}</text>
</box>

## 可展开列表

{@body const [expandedList,setExpandedList] = DIL.useState("用户管理")}
<box border radius="lg" padding={2} gap={1}>
  {#each [{name:"用户管理",items:["用户列表","角色管理","权限设置"]},{name:"订单管理",items:["全部订单","待处理订单","历史订单"]},{name:"系统设置",items:["基本设置","通知设置","安全设置"]}] as group}
    <pressable padding={3} radius="md" onClick={()=>setExpandedList(expandedList===group.name?"":group.name)}>
      <row align="center" justify="between">
        **{group.name}**
        <icon name={expandedList===group.name?"chevron-up":"chevron-down"}/>
      </row>
    </pressable>
    {#if expandedList===group.name}
      <box padding={{left:4,bottom:2}} gap={2}>
        {#each group.items as item}
          <row align="center" gap={2}>
            <icon name="corner-down-right" color="secondary" size="sm"/>
            <text size="sm">{item}</text>
          </row>
        {/each}
      </box>
    {/if}
  {/each}
</box>

## 卡片式列表

<box gap={2}>
  <each values={[{icon:"users",name:"张三",desc:"项目负责人",status:"在线"},{icon:"settings",name:"李四",desc:"开发工程师",status:"离线"}]} alias="item">
    <box border radius="lg" padding={3}>
      <row align="center" gap={3}>
        <box background="surface-secondary" radius="full" size="42px" align="center" justify="center">
          <icon name={item.icon} size="xl"/>
        </box>
        <box flex="1" gap={1}>
          **{item.name}**
          <caption>{item.desc}</caption>
        </box>
        <badge color={item.status==="在线"?"success":"secondary"}>{item.status}</badge>
      </row>
    </box>
  </each>
</box>

## 带复选框的表格

{@body const [rows,setRows] = DIL.useState(["P001"])}
{@body const products = [{id:"P001",name:"产品 A",price:"¥199"},{id:"P002",name:"产品 B",price:"¥299"},{id:"P003",name:"产品 C",price:"¥399"}]}
<box border radius="lg" padding={2} gap={2}>
  <row align="center" justify="between">
    **商品选择表**
    <badge>{rows.length} 项已选</badge>
  </row>
  {#each products as p}
    <row align="center" padding={2}>
      <checkbox checked={rows.includes(p.id)} onChange={v=>setRows(old=>v?[...old,p.id]:old.filter(x=>x!==p.id))}/>
      <box flex="1" gap={1}>
        **{p.name}**
        <caption>{p.id}</caption>
      </box>
      <text tabularNums>{p.price}</text>
    </row>
    <divider color="subtle"/>
  {/each}
  <button block color="secondary" variant="outline" onClick={()=>setRows(products.map(p=>p.id))}>全选</button>
</box>

## 可编辑表格

{@body const [name,setName] = DIL.useState("张三")}
<box border padding={3} gap={2}>
  **编辑用户信息**
  <table label="编辑用户信息">
    <table-row><table-cell>**姓名**</table-cell><table-cell>**职位**</table-cell></table-row>
    <table-row><table-cell>{name}</table-cell><table-cell>经理</table-cell></table-row>
  </table>
  <input value={name} onChange={setName} label="输入内容"/>
</box>

## 带操作按钮的表格

{@body const [actionRows,setActionRows] = DIL.useState(["待处理","待处理","待处理"])}
<box border radius="lg" padding={2}>
  <table>
    <table-row>
      <table-cell>**订单**</table-cell>
      <table-cell>**状态**</table-cell>
      <table-cell align="end">**操作**</table-cell>
    </table-row>
    {#each actionRows as status,i}
      <table-row>
        <table-cell>订单 {i+1}</table-cell>
        <table-cell><badge color={status==="已完成"?"success":"warning"}>{status}</badge></table-cell>
        <table-cell align="end"><button size="xs" disabled={status==="已完成"} onClick={()=>setActionRows(old=>old.map((v,j)=>i===j?"已完成":v))}>完成</button></table-cell>
      </table-row>
    {/each}
  </table>
</box>

## 下拉菜单

{@body const [action,setAction] = DIL.useState("尚未选择")}
<box border padding={3} gap={2}>
  <popover>
    <popover-trigger><button>选择操作</button></popover-trigger>
    <popover-content>
      <box gap={1}>
        <each values={["查看","修改","归档"]} alias="item">
          <pressable padding={2} onClick={()=>setAction(item)}><text>{item}</text></pressable>
        </each>
      </box>
    </popover-content>
  </popover>
  <caption>当前操作：{action}</caption>
</box>

## 上下文菜单

{@body const [context,setContext] = DIL.useState(false)}
{@body const [contextAction,setContextAction] = DIL.useState("暂无操作")}
<box border radius="lg" padding={3} gap={2}>
  <pressable border radius="md" padding={4} align="center" onClick={()=>setContext(!context)}>
    <icon name="file-text" size="2xl"/>
    **项目文件.txt**
    <caption>点击打开上下文菜单</caption>
  </pressable>
  {#if context}
    <box background="surface-secondary" radius="lg" padding={2} gap={1}>
      {#each ["打开","重命名","复制","删除"] as item}
        <pressable padding={2} radius="md" onClick={()=>{setContextAction(item);setContext(false)}}>
          <text size="sm">{item}</text>
        </pressable>
      {/each}
    </box>
  {/if}
  <caption>执行结果：{contextAction}</caption>
</box>

## 菜单列表

{@body const [menu,setMenu] = DIL.useState("首页")}
<box border padding={3} gap={2}>
  <each values={[{name:"首页",icon:"house"},{name:"设置",icon:"settings"}]} alias="item">
    <pressable padding={3} radius="md" background={menu===item.name?"surface-tertiary":"surface"} onClick={()=>setMenu(item.name)}>
      <row align="center" gap={3}>
        <icon name={item.icon}/>
        <box flex="1">{item.name}</box>
        <chat-condition test={menu===item.name}><icon name="check" color="success"/></chat-condition>
      </row>
    </pressable>
  </each>
  <caption>当前菜单：{menu}</caption>
</box>

## 多级菜单

{@body const [level1,setLevel1] = DIL.useState("文件")}
{@body const [level2,setLevel2] = DIL.useState("新建")}
<box border radius="lg" padding={3} gap={2}>
  **一级菜单**
  <radio-group direction="row" value={level1} onChange={v=>{setLevel1(v);setLevel2("")}}>
    <radio value="文件">文件</radio>
    <radio value="编辑">编辑</radio>
    <radio value="视图">视图</radio>
  </radio-group>
  <divider color="subtle"/>
  **二级菜单**
  {#each (level1==="文件"?["新建","打开","保存"]:level1==="编辑"?["撤销","重做","复制"]:["放大","缩小","全屏"]) as item}
    <pressable padding={2} radius="md" background={level2===item?"surface-tertiary":"surface"} onClick={()=>setLevel2(item)}>
      <row justify="between">
        {item}
        {#if level2===item}<icon name="check" color="success"/>{/if}
      </row>
    </pressable>
  {/each}
  <caption>当前路径：{level1} / {level2||"未选择"}</caption>
</box>
